| TBL-SC-03 | PO-SC-P-01..P-04 | extern_spec | serde_json to_string/from_str total on well-formed types | module | round-trip preservation | false | the 4 proptest rows exercise the boundary |
| TBL-SC-04 | PO-SC-V-18,V-19 | extern_spec | Vec::push order-preserving, appends | module | filter+collect semantics | false | (none — Vec semantics are well-known) |
| TBL-SC-05 | PO-SC-V-05 | external_body | fmt::Formatter machinery for &str Display | trait impl | bytes-only equivalence | false | PO-SC-P-05 round-trip |
| TBL-SC-06 | PO-SC-V-01..V-05 | type-system-fact | HoleType is closed 3-variant enum | type | exhaustiveness | false | PO-SC-V-01, V-02, V-03, V-04, V-05 enumerate variants |

### F-BLOCK-008 — `E_CLIPPY_PROPTEST_EXPOSURE` (BLOCKER)

**Artifact:** `proofs/scenario-proof-plan.md` §9 item 4
**Severity:** blocker

**Problem.** Plan §9 acknowledges the proptest submodule needs `#[allow(...)]` but does
not enumerate the specific lints. Scenario.rs lines 1-5 carry module-level
`#![warn(clippy::pedantic)]` and `#![warn(clippy::nursery)]` which override the parent
deny rules. proptest idiom (e.g. `vec![HoleType::DiscoveryHole, HoleType::EdgeCaseHole]`
in `arb_hole_type()`) will trip pedantic-friction warnings.

**Repair.** In §9 item 4, enumerate the allow list for `#[cfg(test)] mod tests_proptest`:

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
#[allow(
  clippy::unwrap_used,
  clippy::expect_used,
  clippy::panic,
  clippy::needless_pass_by_value,
  clippy::redundant_field_names,
  clippy::unnecessary_debug_formatting,
  clippy::option_if_let_else,
  clippy::manual_let_else,
  clippy::match_wild_err_arm,
  clippy::match_like_matches_macro,
  clippy::needless_collect
)]
mod tests_proptest { ... }
```

Reference the existing test module's allow list at lines 326-340 as the template.

**Owner:** `proof-planner` (enum) → `proof-writer` (apply).

## 4. Re-submission checklist

When re-submitting to `proof-plan-reviewer`:

1. [ ] `rust-contract` has authored `clarity-web/src/domain/contract.md` with explicit
       decisions on Q1 and Q2 (and ideally Q3-Q5).
2. [ ] Plan §3 has all 26 clauses marked `AUTHORED` with rust-contract's invocation ID.
3. [ ] Plan §9 item 2 classifies Q1/Q2 as BLOCKING, Q3-Q5 as non-blocking.
4. [ ] Plan §6 produces `proofs/scenario-trusted-base.jsonl` with 10 rows.
5. [ ] Plan §8 produces `proofs/scenario-refinement-obligations.planned.jsonl` with 25
       (or 28, if PO-SC-V-23 is split into 3) rows.
6. [ ] Plan §6 row 8 corrected (line citation 198, no self-contradiction).
7. [ ] Plan §5 row PO-SC-V-23 split into PO-SC-V-23a, V-23b, V-23c.
8. [ ] `scenario-obligations.planned.jsonl` schema_version is `proof-obligation/v1`
       (singular) in all 40+ rows.
9. [ ] Plan §9 item 4 enumerates the specific lint allow list for `tests_proptest`.
10. [ ] The 33 obligations have `clause_origin: AUTHORED` and `requires_contract: false`.

**Smallest state to rerun:** `proof-plan-reviewer` re-invocation with the corrected
artifacts above.
